name: card/spotlight-card
title: Spotlight card
title_vi: Thẻ đèn rọi trên nền ánh sáng
desc_vi: Thẻ kính tối trên nền ánh sáng mờ trôi chậm, một vệt đèn rọi chạy chéo qua thẻ.
params_vi: title, text: tiêu đề và mô tả · scale: độ phóng to (1.65 như bản demo gốc, thẻ gốc 760 x 428 px) · bg: màu nền thẻ · fg: màu chữ · radius: bo góc thẻ
notes: Layout, sizes, colours and motion as in the source (card 760 x 428 px, radius 30; inner card inset 74 / 92 px, radius 26, 1 px rgba(255,255,255,.16) border, rgba(255,255,255,.08) fill; mesh inset -22 %, blur 44 px, opacity .88, three radial gradients; spotlight 260 px radial disc with mix-blend-mode screen). Motion kept: mesh custom properties --hf-x1/y1/x2/y2/x3/y3 from 18/28, 78/46, 44/80 % to 34/42, 62/60, 58/64 % over 4 s sine.inOut; spotlight --hf-spot-x/y from (-120, -70) px to (190, 90) px over 3 s sine.inOut; both start at `at`. The motion is CSS custom property tweens on a blurred gradient with a blend mode, so ae is png. Differences: the source demo wrapped the card in a scale(1.65) frame; here that is the param `scale` (default 1.65) and every px size is multiplied by it, so the card is crisp at any size; the card is centred in the target box; the spotlight is centred with margin auto instead of the source's grid static position; the paragraph size 18 px comes from the source demo (the component itself left it at the browser default); the source's .particle hook (CSS only, no markup in the file; a timeline stub that animates particles if they exist) is not ported. Default texts are Vietnamese (source: English).
